# ShopLinkr

> ShopLinkr is a Dutch WMS and inventory management platform for small and medium webshops. It automates order processing, pick lists, label printing and multi-channel inventory sync across Bol, Shopify, WooCommerce, Kaufland and all major Dutch carriers.

Last updated: 2026-07-18. Dutch version: https://www.shoplinkr.com/llms.txt

## Product
- [Features overview](https://www.shoplinkr.com/en/features): Every ShopLinkr feature on one page.
- [Orders](https://www.shoplinkr.com/en/features/orders): Process orders from Bol, Shopify, WooCommerce and Kaufland in one place.
- [Inventory](https://www.shoplinkr.com/en/features/inventory): Real-time inventory management across all your sales channels, with forecasting and fictitious stock.
- [Products](https://www.shoplinkr.com/en/features/products): A central product overview for stock, variants and bundles.
- [Pick lists](https://www.shoplinkr.com/en/features/pick-lists): Smart pick routes through your warehouse with barcode scanning and label printing.
- [Rules](https://www.shoplinkr.com/en/features/rules): Automate recurring work with conditions and actions.
- [Purchase advice](https://www.shoplinkr.com/en/features/purchase-advice): Smart reordering advice based on sales data and lead times.
- [Locations](https://www.shoplinkr.com/en/features/locations): Hierarchical warehouse locations linked to products.
- [Carriers](https://www.shoplinkr.com/en/features/carriers): Print labels for PostNL, DPD, MyParcel, Sendcloud and more.
- [Returns](https://www.shoplinkr.com/en/features/returns): Process returns and book them back into stock with ease.
- [Reports](https://www.shoplinkr.com/en/features/reports): Insight into bestsellers, dead stock, stock value and ABC analysis.

## Integrations
- [Integrations overview](https://www.shoplinkr.com/en/integrations): All webshop, marketplace and carrier connections.
- [Bol](https://www.shoplinkr.com/en/integrations/bol-com): Sync inventory and orders with Bol.
- [Shopify](https://www.shoplinkr.com/en/integrations/shopify): Inventory sync and order import for Shopify webshops.
- [WooCommerce](https://www.shoplinkr.com/en/integrations/woocommerce): Inventory sync and order import for WooCommerce.
- [Kaufland](https://www.shoplinkr.com/en/integrations/kaufland): Sell on Kaufland with real-time inventory sync.
- [Lightspeed C-Series](https://www.shoplinkr.com/en/integrations/lightspeed-c-series): Inventory sync and order import for Lightspeed C-Series webshops.
